target_customer: Ecommerce merchants (fashion and general retail in Spain, Portugal, Italy, Germany and later US) that pay to run returns and refunds
problem: Online returns are slow and refunds take two weeks or more in Europe, which hurts shopper loyalty and merchant economics.
business_model: B2B SaaS and returns services for merchants with instant refunds financed by REVER
product_category: Ecommerce returns and reverse logistics software

founders.name: Oriol Hernandez i Fajula
founders.background_notes: TechCrunch says both founders were employees of large logistics companies, names not given.

founders.name: Marius Montmany
founders.background_notes: Spelled Marius or Màrius across sources.

competitors.name: Loop Returns
competitors.what: Returns management platform for Shopify merchants
competitors.traction_then: Listed by TechCrunch among rivals in June 2023

technical_complexity.rationale: Merchant integrations, carrier label generation and a refund financing layer are standard engineering with some hard parts in payments and underwriting returns risk.

defensibility.rationale: Integrations with merchants and carriers create some lock-in, but several returns vendors offered similar features and instant refunds were copyable. Financing the refunds needs capital.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: TechCrunch in June 2023 named Shopify, Klarna, Loop Returns, ReturnLogic and Sendcloud as players, some offering instant refunds. No acquisition of REVER found as of the search.

market_need_then: Ecommerce volume grew during the pandemic and retailers such as Boohoo began charging return fees. The founders cite refund waits of 14 days or more in Europe versus near instant delivery.

branding.domain_note: Company uses itsrever.com. Other firms share the name (a motorcycle brand at rever.co and a jewelry company), so the exact .com was not obtainable.

identity.voice_and_tone: Consumer-friendly and ambitious: returns in 2 clicks, refunds in 24h.

branding.community_and_virality: Press coverage focused on funding and the YC batch; a TikTok Shop returns partnership was reported in November 2024.

brand_strength.rationale: Little brand-specific coverage found. Merchant-facing B2B brand with a name shared by unrelated companies.

outcome_analysis: REVER got into YC four months after founding, raised about $1M pre-seed in 2022 and a seed of roughly 7.5 to 8.5 million euros in June 2023 with 130 plus customers and about 25 staff. It is active with a reported TikTok Shop returns partnership, but its own revenue and volume claims are unverified and it faces well funded returns vendors.
notes: Seed size conflicts: company and EU press say 7.5M euros, TechCrunch says 8.5M euros (about $9.29M). USD 8.2M is an aggregator conversion of 7.5M euros. Competitors come from a June 2023 article, eleven months after the batch, because no 2022 dated list was found. The company's claim of 100M euros yearly returns and 50M euros revenue comes from the YC description and a directory and is unverified. Founder prior employers not named in sources.
